question: what clubs does ramapo have
answer:
Ramapo has more than 80 clubs and organizations, across cultural, academic, religious, recreational, entertainment, political, social and special-interest groups. The college’s club directory is https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/ [9,14].

Examples listed in the directory include: Ramapo Lacrosse Club — Athletics — https://archway.ramapo.edu/LacrosseClub/ [1]; Ramapo Esports — Athletics — https://archway.ramapo.edu/espo/ [2]; Ramapo College Ice Hockey Club — Athletics — https://archway.ramapo.edu/IceHockey/ [3]; Ramapo College Indoor Soccer Club — Athletics — https://archway.ramapo.edu/IndoorSoccer/ [4]; Ramapo College Disc Club — Athletics — https://archway.ramapo.edu/RCDC/ [6]; Sports Club — Student Organization — https://archway.ramapo.edu/Sport/ [7]; Ramapo Ultimate Frisbee — Student Organization - Sports / Recreation — https://archway.ramapo.edu/frisbee/ [8]. The directory also lists Ramapo College of New Jersey — Department — https://archway.ramapo.edu/admin/ [5].

Other names shown on the college clubs page include South Asian Club, Spanish Club, Student Government Association (SGA), Students of Caribbean Ancestry (SOCA), Sunrise RCNJ, Syriac Orthodox Club, The Fantasy Film & Novel Society, Trading Card Game Club, Turning Point USA (TPUSA), United Asian Association (UAA), Visual Artists Society (VAS), Women in Business, WRPR, Yearbook Club, and Young Democratic Socialists of America (YDSA). See the page for their individual links. [10]

Competitive sports options listed include cheer, dance, ice hockey, rock climbing, tennis, wrestling, esports and mixed martial arts; details: https://ramapoathletics.com/sports/2018/9/26/intramurals-and-competitive-sports-clubs.aspx [12].

Sources: [1](https://archway.ramapo.edu/LacrosseClub/) [2](https://archway.ramapo.edu/espo/) [3](https://archway.ramapo.edu/IceHockey/) [4](https://archway.ramapo.edu/IndoorSoccer/) [5](https://archway.ramapo.edu/admin/) [6](https://archway.ramapo.edu/RCDC/) [7](https://archway.ramapo.edu/Sport/) [8](https://archway.ramapo.edu/frisbee/) [10](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/) [12](https://www.ramapo.edu/admitted-students/athletic/)

question: is there a latino or hispanic cultural club on campus? how do i join
answer:
Yes. The Spanish Club is a Student Organization; it celebrates Spanish-speaking cultures and offers opportunities to learn about Spanish/Hispanic and Latino culture. Page: https://archway.ramapo.edu/SpanClub/ [1][12] Email spanishclub@ramapo.edu. [12]

The Organization of Latino Unity (OLU) is a Student Organization that brings together students of diverse Latino heritages and plans educational activities. Page: https://archway.ramapo.edu/OLU/ [5][14] Email olu@ramapo.edu. [14]

The Association of Latinos Moving Ahead (ALMA) describes itself as an academic and social Latino organization; everyone is welcome. Email alma08@ramapo.edu. [9]

To join, contact a club at its email above. Clubs welcome new members, and all clubs listed on the college’s clubs page are open to all students. [13] You can also check Archway or stop by the Center for Student Involvement (SC-202) for more information. [11]

Sources: [1](https://archway.ramapo.edu/SpanClub/) [5](https://archway.ramapo.edu/OLU/) [9](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/association-latinos-moving-ahead/) [11](https://www.ramapo.edu/csi/commuter-affairs/involvement-frequently-asked-questions/) [12](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/spanish-club/) [13](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/) [14](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/organization-of-latino-unity-olu/)

question: Hi! I'm a freshman and I want to get involved. What service or volunteering organizations are there, and where can I find a list of all of them?
answer:
The Association of Latinos Moving Ahead (ALMA) is an academic and social organization focused on fundraising and community service activities; everyone is welcome. [10] The Civic and Community Engagement Center (CCEC) also hosts student service trips on weekdays and weekends, but the page does not name the community partners. [13]

Find the list of clubs and organizations at https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/; Ramapo has more than 100. [5][6] You can also explore Archway at http://archway.ramapo.edu/ or download the Archway App. [5]

For service opportunities, contact CCEC at ccec@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7586, or visit SC-213. [13]

Sources: [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/orientation/faq-2/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/orientation/faq/) [10](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/association-latinos-moving-ahead/) [13](https://www.ramapo.edu/ccec/service-partners-and-projects/)

question: is there a business or finance club for professional networking
answer:
Yes. Ramapo lists several relevant clubs:
- Quantitative Finance Club offers networking with alumni, recruiters, and finance professionals, including those from hedge funds and banks. Email: quantitativefinance@ramapo.edu. [11]
- Ramapo Management Consulting Group offers opportunities to network with professionals through lectures and meetings. Email: rmcg@ramapo.edu. [13]
- Roadrunner Financial Group hosts financial-community guest speakers and networking events; all majors may participate. Email: invest@ramapo.edu. [15]
- ALPFA offers networking events and industry panels for students pursuing careers in business, accounting, finance, and related fields. Email: alpfa@ramapo.edu. [16]
- Women in Business fosters relationships and mentorship, and is open to all students. Email: wib@ramapo.edu. [17]

Sources: [11](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/quantitative-finance-club/) [13](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/ramapo-management-consulting-group/) [15](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/roadrunner-financial-group/) [16](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/association-of-latino-professionals-for-america-alpfa/) [17](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/women-in-business/)
